layaR: Local Laya Decision Models via Rust

Source: R/layaR-package.R
layaR-package.Rd

Run Laya System 1 decision models (typed choice, score and yes/no questions with calibrated probabilities) locally from R, through the laya-onnx Rust crate and ONNX Runtime. No Python or server is required at prediction time.

Options

layaR reads these options; set them with options(), for example in your .Rprofile.

  • layaR.checkpoint: the checkpoint laya_default_engine() loads ("multilingual" by default).

  • layaR.threads: the default intra_op_threads for laya_engine() (NULL: ONNX Runtime chooses).

  • layaR.batch_size: the default batch_size for laya_predict_batch() and laya_annotate() (1).

  • layaR.model_root: where models are installed (see laya_model_root()).

  • layaR.model_repo: the Hugging Face repository laya_download_model() uses ("gueyenono/laya-onnx").

  • layaR.shared_cache: FALSE stops layaR from looking for models in the cache shared with Laya's Rust and TypeScript SDKs.
